python_core.name: Python Basics
python_core.description: Core Python programming: syntax, data structures, functions, and reading/writing code comfortably.
python_core.why: The lingua franca of AI — every ML library (NumPy, PyTorch, scikit-learn) is Python-first.

python_data_tools.name: Python for Data (NumPy/Pandas)
python_data_tools.description: Vectorized computation and tabular data with NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib — the data plumbing of ML.
python_data_tools.why: Models eat matrices and tables; this is the vocabulary every pipeline is written in.

linear_algebra.name: Linear Algebra
linear_algebra.description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, and linear transformations — the math deep learning is built on.
linear_algebra.why: A neural network IS matrix multiplication; backprop is a chain rule over weighted sums.

calculus.name: Calculus
calculus.description: Derivatives, integrals, and optimization from a single-variable standpoint.
calculus.why: Gradient descent is pure calculus — you need derivatives to understand how models learn.

probability_stats.name: Probability & Statistics
probability_stats.description: Distributions, Bayes' theorem, expectation, and statistical inference.
probability_stats.why: Learning algorithms reason under uncertainty; probability is their language.

algorithms_data_structures.name: Algorithms & Data Structures
algorithms_data_structures.description: Big-O analysis, trees, graphs, sorting, and dynamic programming.
algorithms_data_structures.why: Sharpens the systematic thinking that makes the harder ML theory tractable.

machine_learning_fundamentals.name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
machine_learning_fundamentals.description: Supervised/unsupervised learning, regression, classification, bias-variance, and evaluation.
machine_learning_fundamentals.why: Gives you the model-building workflow and evaluation mindset before neural networks.

neural_networks.name: Neural Networks
neural_networks.description: Perceptrons, activation functions, forward/backward propagation, and optimization.
neural_networks.why: The core architecture — understand one neuron-to-network before you scale up.

deep_learning.name: Deep Learning
deep_learning.description: CNNs, RNNs, regularization at scale, and modern architectures.
deep_learning.why: The full stack: training deep nets on real data with modern tools.

deep_learning_cv.name: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
deep_learning_cv.description: Convolutional architectures, object detection, segmentation, and transfer learning.
deep_learning_cv.why: Concretizes deep learning on image tasks — the most intuitive visual domain.

natural_language_processing.name: Natural Language Processing
natural_language_processing.description: Tokenization, embeddings, RNNs/attention, and transformers for text.
natural_language_processing.why: Applies the same toolkit to language, the other half of modern AI.

data_science.name: Data Science
data_science.description: End-to-end analysis: cleaning, exploration, modeling, and communicating findings.
data_science.why: Turns the tools into a complete analytical workflow.
